title: Economy Guard: Golden-Anchor Eval Harness for Safe Cost-Tuning
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an evaluation harness ("Economy Guard") that ties batching/caching recommendation engines to a lightweight, automated quality acceptance flow. The harness will run on candidate config diffs (microbatch size, prefix/KV cache enabled, cache retention, quantization profile) and produce deterministic pass/fail signals using a combination of golden-anchor prompts, stratified traffic replay, and statistical similarity tests. This ticket scopes the first end-to-end MVP: a reproducible harness that runs in CI for proposed config changes and a canary gating step for progressive rollout. Goals: reduce unit cost by enabling safe automated applies while keeping semantic drift and hallucination regressions below defined thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible CI job that consumes a config diff and outputs a JSON summary: cost_delta_pct, latency_delta_ms(P50,P95), semantic_similarity_score(mean,ci), hallucination_rate, pass_fail_reason_codes.
Define and document 3 golden-anchor prompt families (short instruction, multi-turn QA, code completion) with at least 200 examples each and stored anchor embeddings in the eval datastore.
Statistical tests implemented: paired bootstrap for semantic similarity, proportion test for hallucination rate, and non-inferiority test for latency where applicable.
A canary gating policy that auto-approves applies when all gates pass, otherwise flags for manual review and triggers rollback automation paths.
Dashboard panels in Console showing historic gate runs, false positive/negative estimates, and correlation between cost savings and semantic drift.
Integrations: GitHub PR comment with summary link, Confluence design doc link, and a runtime-1.20 release note entry.

technical_notes: Harness will accept a candidate config bundle and run three lanes: (1) deterministic golden-anchor evaluation using stored anchors and embedding similarity; (2) stratified replay of sampled production traces (obfuscated) to measure behavioral deltas; (3) microbench for latency/cost profiling. Use our existing KV cache simulator to toggle cache retention and prefix reuse. Similarity metric: mean cosine of text-embedding-ada-like vectors with 95% bootstrap CI; hallucination heuristics will use entity-presence mismatch + model-assertion classifier. Rollback criteria: if semantic_similarity_drop > 0.035 absolute OR hallucination_rate increases > 0.8x relative OR P95 latency regression > 15% then automatic reject and trigger rollback playbook.
rollout_plan: 1) Run harness in CI for all PRs touching cost-config recommender. 2) For accepted PRs, start a 1% canary in dedicated pool for 24h; run Economy Guard on live canary logs. 3) If canary passes, escalate to 10% for 48h; automated apply permitted if gates pass. 4) If any gate fails, auto-rollback and page oncall; create postmortem for manual review. 5) After three successful auto-applies, enable weekly scheduled auto-tuning window with human-in-loop audit samples.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: overfitting golden anchors leads to false negatives and allows regressions in unrepresented workloads. Mitigation: stratified sampling across customers and periodic rotation of anchor sets; add human audit on random samples and monitor false-negative rate. Risk: noisy similarity metric due to embedding drift. Mitigation: baseline and retrain anchor embeddings monthly; include calibration checks before run. Risk: rollout automation misapplies expensive configs. Mitigation: enforce cost_delta_pct cap for auto-apply (<=10%) and maintain manual approval for higher-risk quantization profiles.
